:::{#exm-binomial-coefficient}
#### Subsets of $\set{a, b, c}$ by size
<!-- no-figure: a short list of subsets; nothing to plot -->

The [set](#def-set) $\set{a, b, c}$ has $3$ elements.
Its subsets with exactly $2$ elements are $\set{a, b}$, $\set{a, c}$ and $\set{b, c}$,
so $\binomial{3}{2} = 3$.
Its only subset with $0$ elements is the [empty set](#def-empty-set),
so $\binomial{3}{0} = 1$,
and its only subset with $3$ elements is $\set{a, b, c}$ itself,
so $\binomial{3}{3} = 1$.

:::
